items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: And that's me on the end.

ctx.x: He died. Because the daddy was a bartender. One of them we went through there, he was a bartender at Shoupé. That's a saloon in New Iberia. Yeah. And uh, but San Blanchett, that's the drummer. That's the drummer that old man Adam Lamott taught. Mm-hmm. That's the Lamott brothers' daddy. He taught him how to play drum. And next is Lloyd Lamott, that's old man Lamott's son.
And what's he on? I can't see.
